{{Quote|What's wrong?"<br />"A flock of winged reptiles. They just came from out of nowhere. I almost didn't see them."<br />"It's a good thing you did. They were probably migrating killspikes. Not the smartest avians, but very thick-skinned and they are able to do plenty of damage to low-flying ships.|The [[Skull Queen]] informs [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] about the killspike|<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref>}}
A '''killspike''' was a native [[bird]] of the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nallastia]].

A rather dim-witted avian with extremely thick reptilian skin, the winged killspike migrated in low-flying flocks.<ref name=":0" />

As 18-year-old [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] very nearly discovered in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], piloting a [[Nallastian V-wing]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] while on a [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|mission to Fondor]], the 'winged reptiles' were capable of doing a great deal of damage to low-flying [[Starship/Legends|ships]].<ref name=":0" />
